versions.changelog:
Initial release of mixlab-solo-scope.

- Fetches entries from Solo Scope RSS feed and categorizes them into 3–6 concise topic groups.
- For each group, automatically generates a 140-character core value summary and lists original titles with URLs.
- Provides a ready-to-use Markdown report format.
- Designed for efficient, actionable briefings tailored for solo founders and small teams.
- Triggerable with several short commands related to Solo Scope or mixdao feeds.
